### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3819afeca1307a2c1095ff4abe2eeaa6871d1b2a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5733c1bc6a4a24337de94a5e291f3e89e99833ea` — the merge of head `ca2df4fd69358c2046b56bf2e0ed163fc2c6e9e0` into base `3819afeca1307a2c1095ff4abe2eeaa6871d1b2a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5733c1bc6a4a24337de94a5e291f3e89e99833ea && git checkout 5733c1bc6a4a24337de94a5e291f3e89e99833ea
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3819afeca1307a2c1095ff4abe2eeaa6871d1b2a ca2df4fd69358c2046b56bf2e0ed163fc2c6e9e0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3819afeca1307a2c1095ff4abe2eeaa6871d1b2a && git merge --no-ff ca2df4fd69358c2046b56bf2e0ed163fc2c6e9e0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3819afeca1307a2c1095ff4abe2eeaa6871d1b2a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：示例数据里有一类记录，它关联的人当时还没注册。这类记录被人手动删掉后，下次加载示例数据不会再自己冒出来；那个人后来注册了，也不会。
- 为什么做：以前这类记录删了还会被重新插回去，用户的删除不算数。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是被删的这类记录照旧又出现一次，和修之前一样；其他示例数据照常加载，主动重新灌示例数据时仍会恢复全部记录。
- 要你做什么：不需要你做任何事，区域审完自己落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `ca2df4fd69358c2046b56bf2e0ed163fc2c6e9e0` · 2026-11-19T06:44Z

- **形态** — 3 files, +160/−2 (162 lines): `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`, the #34800 harness test file, and one changeset. Base `81c09477`, main moved K=13 first-parent commits (< 15, no merge needed). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 35361`: not governed, under the 3000-line limit. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Fixes vs card #34856** — the card offers two remedies; this PR takes the second, the derived id. `deferredLandedKey` is `seedLandedKey({ id: seedDeferredKeyRowId(objectName, org, authoredKey) }, 'id')`, using the same three arguments as the id the row actually lands with (`seed-loader.ts` ~:2810). It is read before any reference resolves, so it is the same on the landing load, on a load where the reference is still empty, and on a load where it has resolved. Recording: when `landedKeyOf` is `''` and the row deferred a key field, the row goes into `landedKeyByRecordIndex` under that key. `isWithdrawnRow` traced case by case:
  - key `''` → no longer returns false early;
  - row still present by key or by id → not withdrawn;
  - complete key recorded → withdrawn, as before;
  - otherwise withdrawn iff the deferred key is recorded.
  A row that landed with its key complete is never recorded under a deferred id, so the new branch cannot match it.
- **Changeset** — `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, read sentence by sentence against the diff and pins. The `landedKeys: 'honour'` condition, the old "recorded under no key" cause, recording under the id derived from the authored key, the still-empty and resolved-since cases, and the two controls (never landed here still lands; a deliberate re-seed brings it back) all match.
- **Pins** — new `describe` in `seed-loader-deferred-key-reference.test.ts`:
  - ignore and upsert × (deleted while the reference is still empty / deleted, then the person signs up), each asserting 0 inserted and 1 skipped over two further loads;
  - the ledger row stored under the derived `seed_` id;
  - CONTROL: a complete-key row stays deleted as before;
  - CONTROL: a never-landed deferred row still lands beside a withdrawn one;
  - CONTROL: a deliberate re-seed restores it.
- **门禁** — 53 check-runs on this head: 37 success, 16 skipped (path-filtered), 0 failure.
- **接受的偏差** — (1) The pins are folded into the existing #34800 file as a top-level describe rather than a new card-named file. That is what AGENTS.md asks when a component has a shared harness file, so it is correct, not a deviation. (2) The pins run the real `SeedLoaderService` over the harness engine double, not ObjectQL with SqlDriver, because those are not dependencies of `metadata-protocol`. Accepted: the behaviour sits in the loader's ledger logic, not in the driver. (3) A withdrawn deferred row also rolls back its `referencesDeferred` and `deferredUpdates`, the same way the row already rolled back `referencesResolved`. Without that, pass 2 would try to write onto a row that is not there and report a dropped reference. Accepted, and covered by `second.success === true` in the still-missing pin.
- **范围外去向** — none found.
- **落地条款** — not governed: pkg-1 lands this head after this ACCEPT. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.
